note: No infinite authorization by omission: a record without expires_at is invalid. revocation_status is derived from revocations.json and never stored on a record. Authorization never transfers to a successor artifact.
purpose: Sealed authorization records, bound to the exact artifact. Empty means no authorization decision has been recorded. The repository may derive NOT_AUTHORIZED, BLOCKED, or REQUIRES_MORE_EVIDENCE; AUTHORIZED validates only over the satisfied five-source Phase 9 floor, an assigned release authority, a SATISFIED security gate, SUFFICIENT alpha evidence under an active policy, every blocking condition FALSE, and an explicit expiry.
